title: Exact Algorithms for Multiagent Path Finding with Communication Constraints on Tree-Like Structures
abstract: arXiv:2412.08556v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Consider the scenario where multiple agents have to move in an optimal way through a network, each one towards their ending position while avoiding collisions. By optimal, we mean as fast as possible, which is evaluated by a measure known as the makespan of the proposed solution. This is the setting studied in the Multiagent Path Finding problem. In this work, we additionally provide the agents with a way to communicate with each other. Due to size constraints, it is reasonable to assume that the range of communication of each agent will be limited. What should be the trajectories of the agents to, additionally, maintain a backbone of communication? In this work, we study the Multiagent Path Finding with Communication Constraint problem under the parameterized complexity framework. translated_title: 树状结构上带通信约束的多智能体路径寻找的精确算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2412.08556v4 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：考虑这样一个场景：多个智能体需要在一个网络中以最优方式移动，每个智能体都要前往各自的终点位置，同时避免相互碰撞。所谓最优，是指尽可能快地完成，这通过一个称为所提解决方案的完工时间（makespan）的度量来评估。这就是多智能体路径寻找（Multiagent Path Finding）问题所研究的设定。在这项工作中，我们额外为智能体提供了一种彼此通信的方式。由于尺寸的限制，合理地假设每个智能体的通信范围是有限的。那么，智能体应当采取怎样的轨迹，才能在移动的同时维持一个通信骨干网络？在这项工作中，我们在参数化复杂性框架下研究了带通信约束的多智能体路径寻找问题。我们的主要贡献是三个精确算法，当输入网络具有特定结构时，这些算法是高效的。我们提供了这样一个……
tldr: 本文在参数化复杂性框架下研究了带通信约束的多智能体路径寻找问题，提出了三个在树状结构等特定网络上高效的精确算法，使智能体在避碰移动的同时维持通信骨干网络。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the Multiagent Path Finding with Communication Constraint problem under the parameterized complexity framework and contributes three exact algorithms that are efficient on tree-like network structures, enabling agents to move collision-free while maintaining a communication backbone.
